title: Change or update MQTT server
description: Connect over managed SSH to apply an MQTT server's current settings and device credentials. Enrollment, configuration and runtime state are preserved.
addressDescription: Enter the CC100's private IPv4 address on its new network. This updates where Attraccess connects; the CC100 is already on that network. Its saved SSH host fingerprint must match.
refreshDescription: Select the current server again to refresh its address or credentials. Choose address only when the broker settings do not need to change.
retryDescription: This change needs to finish before another controller operation can start. Retry applies the saved settings and credentials.
statusUnavailable: Connection settings could not be loaded. Close and reopen Advanced to retry.
serversUnavailable: MQTT servers could not be loaded. Close and reopen Advanced to retry.
managementRequired: Automatic SSH management must be active to change these settings.
actionFailed: The action could not finish. Check that no other controller operation is running, then retry. For credential retirement, check the previous broker's connection and ensure it is distinct from the current broker.
success: MQTT settings applied and the device's new login confirmed.
addressSuccess: CC100 address saved and SSH identity verified.
retirementDescription: Previous broker credentials are retained for cleanup. Migration does not require the previous broker to be reachable. Retire them when that broker is available.

phases.connecting: Verifying SSH at the new address
phases.applying: Applying settings and recreating the runtime
phases.verifying: Confirming the device's authenticated MQTT login

failures.host_identity: The SSH host key does not match this CC100. Verify its address and identity. A different host key will not be accepted automatically.
failures.authentication: The managed SSH key was rejected. Check that this is the enrolled CC100 and that managed SSH access is still active.
failures.offline: The CC100 could not be reached over SSH at the entered address. Check its IP, power, network route and SSH port 22, then retry.
failures.management_required: The saved managed credentials could not be verified. Check managed access recovery before retrying this change.
failures.broker_configuration: Check the selected MQTT server's hostname, port and TLS certificate settings in Attraccess, then retry.
failures.broker_provisioning: Device credentials could not be provisioned. Check the selected broker's management connection and credential provider, then retry.
failures.broker_verification: The device's new MQTT login was not confirmed. Check that the CC100 can reach the selected broker and that its TLS settings are correct, then retry the saved change.
failures.host_connection: This Attraccess API does not support refreshing its MQTT connection. Install the matching API version and restart it, then retry the saved change.
failures.runtime_assets: The signed management helper is unavailable. Check the installed CC100 runtime assets, then retry.
failures.incompatible: The controller's managed helper could not be updated or verified. Check its supported runtime and SSH management installation, then retry.
failures.host_gate: The hardware safety check prevented startup. Check the controller's hardware profile, I/O access and supervisor diagnostics, then retry the saved change.
failures.codesys_active: CODESYS is still controlling the outputs. Stop CODESYS on the CC100 before retrying the saved change.
failures.codesys_boot_enabled: CODESYS is configured to start at boot. Disable its boot entry before retrying the saved change.
failures.io_unavailable: A required I/O register or serial device is missing or inaccessible. Check the hardware profile, device paths and runtime permissions, then retry.
failures.writer_conflict: Another process or container can write to the outputs. Stop the conflicting writer and verify the enrolled runtime container, then retry.
failures.ssh_agent: Attraccess could not use its SSH authentication agent. Check that ssh-agent and ssh-add are available to the API process, then retry.
failures.unknown: The saved change could not finish. Check SSH reachability, controller storage and hardware supervisor diagnostics, then retry. The saved operation will finish applying the same settings.
